title: Nicolas Cage tossed $65K engagement ring he gave Lisa Marie Presley OVERBOARD amid searing row - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam S. Levy ,
5 hours ago
Nicolas Cage and the late Lisa Marie Presley ’s romance got so intense, the Oscar-winning actor once tossed a $65,000 engagement ring into the ocean amid 'another of their epic fights.'
The expensive outburst was described in a newly-released book penned by the late star's mother Priscilla Presley , 80, titled Softly, As I Leave You: Live After Elvis.
In the book, which was released Tuesday, Priscilla said a furious Cage threw 'stunning … six-carat, $65,000 diamond ring' off the side of the vessel during a boat trip in Southern California .
'One afternoon, they went sailing off the coast of Catalina Island on Nick's yacht, the Weston,' Priscilla said.
She said that 'something set off another of their epic fights, and Lisa pulled off her engagement ring and threw it at Nick.'
The Leaving Las Vegas star responded by taking the piece of jewelry and depositing it into the Pacific Ocean.
The Academy Award-winning actor was pictured earlier this year in LA at the Saturn Awards 'Furious, Nick threw the ring overboard,' Priscilla said.
Priscilla said that while Cage dispatched a team of divers to try to find the $65,000 ring, she didn’t believe that it was ever retrieved.
'As far as I know, the ring is still there,' Priscilla said.
The star of films such as Con Air, Face/Off and The Rock immediately replaced the piece of jewelry with an even grander one, according to Priscilla.
Cage – w ho has a history of spotty finances – purchased the late Lisa Marie 'an even bigger diamond (ten carats), and they got engaged all over again,' Priscilla wrote.
Priscilla estimated the replacement ring to be about ten carats in size.
Cage and Lisa Marie began dating in 2000 and got married in 2002, but broke up later that year, with their divorce being finalized in 2004.
Daily Mail has reached out to reps for Cage for further comment on the story.

Lisa Marie and Keough had welcomed two children: late son Benjamin, who tragically died at 27 in August of 2020; and daughter Riley, 36, who has emerged as a force on her own in the entertainment industry.
Lisa Marie was also mom to twins Harper and Finley, 16, with her ex-husband Michael Lockwood.
Lisa tragically died in January of 2023 at the age of 54.
